title: cistus marifolius var. vinealis
intro: Cistus marifolius var. vinealis, commonly known as Rockrose, is a Mediterranean plant species that belongs to the Cistaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and fighting against bacteria, making it a potential remedy for various health issues. The therapeutic actions of Rockrose include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and wounds. Bioactive constituents present in Rockrose include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
